We Fix Hacked Website Today

Hacked Website Repair in Houston, TX — Same-Day Malware Cleanup & WordPress Fixes

When your website stops loading, refuses to save updates, redirects to unknown sites, or suddenly shows a blank screen, the disruption to your business is immediate. At WevTEC, we specialize in same-day hacked website repair for Houston-area businesses. With more than 12 years of national experience and hundreds of successful malware cleanups, we provide deep technical recovery using advanced malware removal, code repair, database restoration, hosting reinstatement, and Google warning removal. Every cleanup includes encrypted backups, full restoration, and a 30-day malware guarantee, ensuring long-term stability and peace of mind.

Your website is repaired fast, protected thoroughly, and restored fully — and you pay only after it’s online and functioning correctly.

Fix My Hacked Website Now
Emergency Website Repair

When Houston Websites Get Hacked — Early Symptoms You Should Never Ignore

Houston business owners often notice small glitches before a site fully breaks. A page refuses to save. A plugin won’t update. Forms stop working. The dashboard becomes unusually slow. These minor issues often signal silent malware spreading behind the scenes.

As the infection grows, the symptoms become unmistakable:

  • Blank “White Screen of Death”
  • Admin login suddenly stopped working
  • Pages, posts, or products not saving
  • Unexpected redirects to spam or adult websites
  • Pop-ups or ads that you never added
  • New unknown administrators appearing in your dashboard
  • Themes or plugins breaking for no reason
  • Website suspension from GoDaddy, HostGator, Bluehost, SiteGround, or Cloudways
  • Google showing warnings like “This site may be hacked”
  • Website layouts collapsing on mobile
  • Site loading differently from one device to another

By the time these signs appear, the infection is already deep. We remove both visible malware and hidden backdoors to restore complete stability.

Restore My Website Today

Houston Small Businesses Rely on Us for Rapid Website Repair

From medical offices in Medical Center, law firms in Downtown Houston, restaurants in Katy, real estate companies in Spring, retailers in Sugar Land, and service providers in Cypress — Houston’s business community relies on their websites to operate and grow.

When your website goes down:

  • Leads disappear
  • Sales drop
  • Google rankings decline
  • Customers lose trust immediately

WevTEC provides full-scale hacked website repair designed specifically for Houston’s competitive and fast-paced market. We detect every infection, remove malware completely, repair corrupted code, restore functionality, and bring your website online — typically within hours.

Houston businesses appreciate our transparency, fair pricing, and fast communication throughout the entire repair process.

Make My Website Safe Again

Advanced Website Recovery & Google Warning Removal for Houston, TX

  • Fixing themes and plugin files damaged by malware

If Google has flagged your Houston site with warnings like:

We diagnose the cause, clean the infected files, remove spam pages indexed in Google, and submit a Security Review request. Whether your business is located in Downtown Houston, Galleria/Uptown, Westchase, Energy Corridor, Katy, Cypress, Sugar Land, Pearland, Spring, or The Woodlands, your website is often the first impression clients receive.
